title: Boiler Purge, Minimum-Run, and Anti-Cycle Timing
description: Runs Boiler-1 through purge and ignition, an early stop request held by minimum-run protection, and an immediate restart request blocked by the local anti-cycle timer.

events.description: Request the first burner start through the manager
Request an immediate restart during anti-cycle
Request final normal stop after second-start evidence

expected_results: Start Permissive proves after the circulator responds; Operating State remains purge/ignition (2) until the 35-second sequence finishes
The early manager enable turns off while Boiler OK stays active and Minimum Run Hold is true
The restart request is blocked with Anti-Recycle active until the 60-second minimum-off period clears
A second purge/ignition sequence completes and Start Count reaches two
completion_criteria: Student separates manager request, local start permissive, purge/ignition, proof, firing rate, and thermal output
Student identifies a timer-controlled restart rather than an ignition failure
instructor_notes: Run at 10x for roughly 33 seconds. The manager remains the WebCTRL staging front door; local unit timing cannot be bypassed by the manager command.
student_objectives: Interpret boiler purge, minimum-run, and anti-cycle states
Use start counters and timer telemetry to validate a complete restart
